summary: The narrator Cas Russell refuses DHS paramedics and debriefing after a confrontation in which agents captured her group and she claims she was tortured. Arthur tells the agents to leave her alone, and Agent Jones seems to switch sides and clear a path. Pilar drives Cas and Arthur away in Arthur's rental, arranging a doctor to meet them at Checker's place. Cas gives instructions to protect the others and keeps a gun for protection, while worrying the NSA may still be tracking them.
one_line: Cas Russell escapes DHS custody with Arthur and Pilar, heads to Checker's for medical help, and keeps a gun while worrying about NSA tracking.
key_facts: Cas Russell refused to be treated by the DHS paramedics, even when agents threatened her and said they needed a debriefing.
Cas told the agents that Caleb lives next to the European Central Bank and that they tortured her.
Cas said she would shoot anyone who tried to stop her from leaving.
Arthur firmly told someone that if they needed anything else from Cas, they could ask him.
Agent Jones, in full tac gear, began yelling at people and clearing a path for Cas and Arthur after Arthur spoke.
Cas told Arthur to go with Martinez and make sure she was okay.
Cas warned that she would destroy the DHS if they tried to bury either Arthur or the professor in a hole.
Agent Jones said, "We aren't the bad guys, Ms. Russell," before leaving.
Pilar Velasquez handed Cas her little CZ pistol, and Cas took the safety off and tucked it into her belt.
Arthur told Cas that the NSA was not interested in her and that she was not important to them.
Pilar drove Arthur's rental car and adjusted the seat and mirrors before starting.
Cas chose to go to Checker's, avoiding giving away any of her bolt holes in case the NSA was still tracking them.
Checker told them to come over immediately before Cas keeled over dead, as relayed by Pilar.
Pilar called Arthur's doctor friend, and asked whether the doctor remembered Cas Russell.
